body: Did this error happen after a recent update?

@ea-liwei that seems like a bug, but you should anyway port that validation rule as a table rule instead:

http://book.cakephp.org/3.0/en/orm/saving-data.html#applying-application-rules
Same error for me after update 5 minutes ago.
why would you have a a boolean column that is nullable when the semantics is that it can either be deleted or not?

@lorenzo delete is a DateTime column. It is NULL if the item is NOT deleted, otherwise it's the date/time it has been deleted. This way we know when the item has been deleted. 

It's pretty much like the 'modified' column.

oh, I see... The way you used is not the correct one, and it does not actually work, it was probably not working either with the old `validateUnique` method. I will think about a way of solving this case.
